meaning: The same scheduled reference duration; this is not a measured speed limit.
Typical error magnitude from 3,301 saved samples at t = 25–58 s. Lower means closer to the timed reference.
Largest recorded 3D departure. It exposes excursions that RMS can hide.

Squared error accumulated over time; gives large departures more weight.
Largest total tilt reported by the runner, including takeoff and landing.
How often the commanded tilt reached its configured bound. Zero does not prove that motors never saturated.
Includes takeoff, stabilization, lap, hold and landing.
